# The wind flag's pole: 3.2 m, white, on a little slate block. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pole --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Foot --base-color 0.3765 0.4235 0.5059 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pole --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 3.2 --location 0 0 1.6
material assign Pole
add mesh cube --name Foot --size 1 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 0.4 0.4 0.24
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Knob --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0 0 3.25
material assign Foot
select all
shade flat
export flagpole.glb
